snippet.title: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand Musical Performance - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Developers Friday Sundae shared a musical performance from There Are No Ghosts at the Grand, the studio's Lovecraftian renovation game... that also happens to be a musical. It's coming to PC & Xbox later this year, and your wishlists very soon, we hope.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725190/There_Are_No_Ghosts_at_the_Grand/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
